name: 45 Eugenia
blurb: A 200-kilometre asteroid in the main belt with two small moons of its own.

name: 324 Bamberga
blurb: One of the largest and darkest asteroids in the main belt, about 230 kilometres across.

name: 2867 Steins
blurb: A small, diamond-shaped asteroid visited by the Rosetta spacecraft in 2008. Faint: a test of the search.

name: 10 Hygiea
blurb: The fourth-largest object in the asteroid belt, about 430 kilometres across and nearly round.

name: 7 Iris
blurb: A bright, stony asteroid about 200 kilometres across: one of the brightest in the sky.
